title: Supportive but mixed
transcript: Supervisor: You did a good job keeping the client updated, and the team appreciated your collaboration. I do want you to flag risks earlier and make your weekly updates more consistent. Your documentation has improved a lot this month.

title: High growth area
transcript: Supervisor: You are responsive and eager to learn, but I still need to see stronger ownership when work gets blocked. Please bring issues up sooner and connect your tasks to the larger system, not just the immediate request.

title: Strong performer
transcript: Supervisor: Your preparation was excellent, your handoff notes were detailed, and your follow-through made the project smoother for everyone. I would like you to keep sharing progress updates more proactively with the rest of the team.
